title: Lack of exponential stability for thermoelastic Timoshenko and Bresse systems with full homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions
summary: In this paper we prove that the classical thermoelastic Timoshenko and Bresse systems with thermal coupling acting only on the bending moment are not exponentially stable under full homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions if the equal wave speed condition is not satisfied. Combined with their well-known converses, our results provide complete characterizations of exponential stability in terms of the coefficients of each system.
